v7-baseline.metric_semantics: Paint timings are actual WebEngine Canvas draw durations. Active frame intervals exclude gaps >=100 ms; their reciprocal is not whole-session FPS. Event-to-paint begins at JS pointer handler. IPC pauses are excluded from that latency.
